name: BK Group Plc
source: BK Group Plc Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of cash flows, page 114 (audited, for the year ended 31 December 2025). Unit Frw thousands in the report; multiplied by 1,000 to absolute FRW. Operating cash flow is the printed net cash generated from operating activities; investing is the printed net cash flows used in investing activities; financing is the printed net cash flows used in financing activities; net change in cash is the printed net increase in cash and cash equivalents. Capital expenditure is the sum of the printed purchases of property and equipment and of intangible assets, so it is stored negative and free cash flow equals operating cash flow plus capital expenditure. PDF hosted at drive.google.com/file/d/12cVdoJIO-3jn7KvNJTgdC5h4DkdalhvV, linked from the AfricanFinancials document page.
source_note: Frw thousands times 1,000 to absolute FRW. The printed statement carries a 15,000 (Frw thousands) internal rounding difference in the 2025 column: its working capital lines sum to 137,112,498 against a printed subtotal of 137,097,498, so the three activity totals sum to 78,050,506 against the printed net increase of 78,065,506. The 2024 column ties to the unit. Every figure stored here is a printed subtotal; none is re-derived to force the tie, and the printed net increase is independently reproduced by the closing less opening cash and cash equivalents (541,388,920 less 463,323,414 = 78,065,506).
